content:
Please see the screenshot that i've attached.

I am stretching my limits BEYOND "Pushing my Limits". And this is what i get as "technical support" from LinkedIn.

ABSOLUTELY UNRELIABLE BEHAVIOUR ON MY LAPTOP.

I was typing in my response to Dheeraj Kumar, who replied to my specific comment on a post deriding the Director, IIT Mandi. I was horrified that even after three attempts to type in specific, yet pointed replies, the entire thread became untraceable.

When i am being absolutely sincere in sharing my knowledge and experiences for the greater good, i do expect some basic level of technical support while i type in my inputs via my mobile phone.

It's 02:24 hrs., now, and i have to wake up to catch a flight in the morning. I'll push my body beyond what it can take, because Truths are far more important than my bodily existence on Earth.

I wish to inform ALL who have interacted with me that 

I HAVE DECIDED TO DITCH LINKEDIN COMPLETELY.

I have NOT held any malice towards anyone. Yes, i may have been seen as irritating by one or two co-Members. I can't do anything about others' perceptions of me. Nor can anyone else do.

My last plea is:
Please let us ALL work together and contribute to a more peaceful world. We deserve it. Our children deserve it. Their children deserve it ...... ETERNALLY, and until our Sun becomes a Red Giant.
comment: Digital platforms are now part of professional workflows, so reliability matters. A useful safeguard is keeping offline copies of longer responses before posting, especially for complex discussions.
